title: Create a model group, place it twice, and edit it so every placed instance changes
task: Make a repeated assembly as a model Group (Document.Create.NewGroup), place more instances with PlaceGroup, then change the group so all instances update: there is no group edit mode in the API, so UngroupMembers one instance, edit the loose elements, NewGroup them into a new GroupType and set Group.GroupType on the others. Move a placed group by the Group's id, never a member's.

pitfalls.symptom: 'Changes to groups are allowed only in group edit mode... Use the Ungroup option'; run rolled back.
pitfalls.cause: Two or more instances placed; Revit refuses in-place member edits (one instance: allowed with a warning). There is no group-edit-scope API.
pitfalls.fix: Ungroup one instance, edit, regroup into a new GroupType, reassign the other instances (steps 4-6).

pitfalls.symptom: ElementTransformUtils.MoveElement on a group member does nothing: no error, no warning, no movement.
pitfalls.cause: Members of a placed group cannot be moved individually.
pitfalls.fix: Move the Group's own id; every member moves with it (step 3).

pitfalls.symptom: Member ElementIds captured before setting Group.GroupType no longer resolve.
Verifying by comparing member coordinates to PlaceGroup's origin argument gives a false negative.
pitfalls.cause: Placed members are not at the absolute coordinates the origin implies.
pitfalls.fix: Compare instances of the same GroupType against each other or against the definition.
